verses.geez:
ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤ አዝዞሙ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወለደቂቁ ፡ ወበሎሙ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሕጉ ፡
                  ለመሥዋዕት ፡ ወከመዝ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሥርዐታ ፤ ለመሥዋዕት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ተኀድግዎ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይጸብሕ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ትነድድ
                  ፡ እሳተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Grăit-a iarăşi Domnul cu Moise şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων,

verses.geez:
ወይለብስ ፡ ካህን ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ዐጌ ፡ ወቃሰ ፡ ዘዐጌ ፡ ይለብስ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ ወያሴስል ፡ ሐመደ ፡ ዘበልዐት ፡
                  እሳተ ፡ መሥዋዕት ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወያነብሮ ፡ ቅሩበ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ።
verses.translation: Charge Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of whole-burnt-offering; this is the whole-burnt-offering in its burning on the altar all the night till the morning; and the fire of the altar shall burn on it, it shall not be put out.

translations.lxx: Charge Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of whole-burnt-offering; this is the whole-burnt-offering in its burning on the altar all the night till the morning; and the fire of the altar shall burn on it, it shall not be put out.
translations.kjv: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD, and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;
translations.ron: "Dacă cineva va greşi şi cu bună ştiinţă va nesocoti poruncile Domnului, tăgăduind înaintea aproapelui său ceea ce acesta i-a încredinţat, sau i-a lăsat în păstrare, sau ceea ce i-a furat, sau va înşela pe aproapele său,
translations.grk: ἔντειλαι τῷ Ἀαρὼν καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ, λέγων, οὗτος ὁ νόμος τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως· αὕτη ἡ ὁλοκαύτωσις ἐπὶ τῆς καύσεως αὐτῆς ἐπὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου ὅλην τὴν νύκτα ἕως τοπρωῒ, καὶ τὸ πῦρ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καυθήσεται ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ, οὐ σβεσθήσεται.

verses.geez:
ወያሴስል ፡ ውእተ ፡ አልባሲሁ ፡ ወይለብስ ፡ ካልአ ፡ አልባሰ ፡ ወይወስድ ፡ ሐመደ ፡ አፍአ ፡ እምትዕይንት ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  መካን ፡ ንጹሕ ።
verses.translation: And the priest shall put on the linen tunic, and he shall put the linen drawers on his body; and shall take away that which has been thoroughly burnt, which the fire shall have consumed, even the whole-burnt-offering from the altar, and he shall put it near the altar.

translations.lxx: And the priest shall put on the linen tunic, and he shall put the linen drawers on his body; and shall take away that which has been thoroughly burnt, which the fire shall have consumed, even the whole-burnt-offering from the altar, and he shall put it near the altar.
translations.kjv: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:
translations.ron: Sau găsind un lucru pierdut şi tăgăduind înaintea lui, sau jurându-se strâmb pentru ceva, ce atrage pedeapsă asupra oamenilor,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐνδύσεται ὁ ἱερεὺς χιτῶνα λινοῦν, καὶ περισκελὲς λινοῦν ἐνδύσεται περὶ τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀφελεῖ τὴν κατακάρπωσιν, ἣν ἂν καταναλώσῃ τὸ πῦρ, τὴν ὁλοκαύτωσιν ἀπὸ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου· καὶ παραθήσει αὐτὸ ἐχόμενον τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου.

verses.geez:
ወእሳትሰ ፡ ትነድድ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወኢትጠፍዕ ፡ ወያነድድ ፡ ዕፀወ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ካህን ፡ በበነግህ ፡ ወይዌጥሕ ፡
                  ላዕሌሁ ፡ ዘመሥዋዕት ፡ ወይወዲ ፡ ውስቴቱ ፡ ሥብሐ ፡ ዘመድኀኒት ።
verses.translation: And he shall put off his robe, and put on another robe, and he shall take forth the offering that has been burnt without the camp into a clean place.

translations.lxx: And he shall put off his robe, and put on another robe, and he shall take forth the offering that has been burnt without the camp into a clean place.
translations.kjv: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,
translations.ron: Dacă se va dovedi că a greşit şi s-a făcut vinovat, să întoarcă ce a furat, sau ce a răpit, sau ce i-a fost încredinţat, sau ce a fost pierdut şi găsit de el.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκδύσεται τὴν στολὴν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐνδύσεται στολὴν ἄλλην· καὶ ἐξοίσει τὴν κατακάρπωσιν ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς εἰς τόπον καθαρόν.

verses.geez: ወእሳትሰ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ ትነድድ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወኢይጠፍእ ።
verses.translation: And the fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, and shall not be extinguished; and the priest shall burn on it wood every morning, and shall heap on it the whole-burnt-offering, and shall lay on it the fat of the peace-offering.

translations.lxx: And the fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, and shall not be extinguished; and the priest shall burn on it wood every morning, and shall heap on it the whole-burnt-offering, and shall lay on it the fat of the peace-offering.
translations.kjv: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.
translations.ron: Tot lucrul, pentru care s-a jurat strâmb, să-l plătească deplin şi să mai adauge pe deasupra a cincea parte din preţul lui şi să dea aceluia, al căruia este lucrul, în ziua când îşi va cunoaşte vina sa.
translations.grk: Καὶ πῦρ ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον καυθήσεται ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐ σβεσθήσεται· καὶ καύσει ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ ὁ ἱερεὺς ξύλα τοπρωῒ πρωῒ, καὶ στοιβάσει ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ τὴν ὁλοκαύτωσιν, καὶ ἐπιθήσει ἐπʼ αὐτὸ τὸ στέαρ τοῦ σωτηρίου.

verses.geez: ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለመሥዋዕት ፡ ዘያበውኡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And the fire shall always burn on the altar; it shall not be extinguished.

translations.lxx: And the fire shall always burn on the altar; it shall not be extinguished.
translations.kjv: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:
translations.ron: Iar pentru vina sa să ia din turma de oi un berbec fără meteahnă, după preţuirea ta, şi să-l aducă Domnului prin preot, jertfă pentru vină.
translations.grk: Καὶ πῦρ διαπαντὸς καυθήσεται ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον, οὐ σβεσθήσεται.

verses.geez:
ወይነሥእ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ በሕፍኑ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ስንዳሌ ፡ ዘመሥዋዕት ፡ ምስለ ፡ ቅብኡ ፡ ወምስለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ስኂኑ ፡ ዘሀሎ
                  ፡ ውስተ ፡ መሥዋዕቱ ፡ ወይወድዮ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ እስመ ፡ ቍርባነ ፡ ዝክሩ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለመዐዛ ፡ ሠናይ ፡
                  ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: This is the law of the sacrifice, which the sons of Aaron shall bring near before the Lord, before the altar.

translations.lxx: This is the law of the sacrifice, which the sons of Aaron shall bring near before the Lord, before the altar.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.
translations.ron: Preotul îl va curăţi înaintea Domnului şi i se va ierta orice ar fi făptuit şi oricum s-ar fi făcut vinovat".
translations.grk: Οὗτος ὁ νόμος τῆς θυσίας, ἣν προσάξουσιν αὐτὴν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἀαρὼν ἔναντι Κυρίου, ἀπέναντι τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου.

verses.geez:
ወዘተርፈ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ይበልዑ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወደቂቁ ፡ ወናእተ ፡ ይበልዕዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መካን ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐጸደ ፡
                  ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ይበልዕዎ ።
verses.translation: And he shall take from it a handful of the fine flour of the sacrifice with its oil, and with all its frankincense, which are upon the sacrifice; and he shall offer up on the altar a burnt-offering as a sweet-smelling savour, a memorial of it to the Lord.

translations.lxx: And he shall take from it a handful of the fine flour of the sacrifice with its oil, and with all its frankincense, which are upon the sacrifice; and he shall offer up on the altar a burnt-offering as a sweet-smelling savour, a memorial of it to the Lord.
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀφελεῖ ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ τῇ δρακὶ ἀπὸ τῆς σεμιδάλεως τῆς θυσίας σὺν τῷ ἐλαίῳ αὐτῆς, καὶ σὺν παντὶ τῷ λιβάνῳ αὐτῆς, τὰ ὄντα ἐπὶ τῆς θυσίας· καὶ ἀνοίσει ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον κάρπωμα ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας, τὸ μνημόσυνον αὐτῆς τῷ Κυρίῳ.

verses.geez: ወኢያብሕእዎ ፡ ለአብስሎ ፤
verses.translation: And Aaron and his sons shall eat that which is left of it: it shall be eaten without leaven in a holy place, they shall eat it in the court of the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: And Aaron and his sons shall eat that which is left of it: it shall be eaten without leaven in a holy place, they shall eat it in the court of the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.
translations.ron: "Porunceşte lui Aaron şi fiilor lui şi le zi: Rânduiala arderii de tot este aceasta: arderea de tot să rămână pe vatra jertfelnicului toată noaptea până dimineaţa şi focul jertfelnicului să ardă pe el şi să nu se stingă.
translations.grk: Τὸ δὲ καταλειφθὲν ἀπʼ αὐτῆς ἔδεται Ἀαρὼν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ· ἄζυμα βρωθήσεται ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ· ἐν αὐλῇ τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἔδονται αὐτήν.

verses.geez:
ክፍሎሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ዘወሀብክዎሙ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ መሥዋዕቱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ለቅዱሳን ፡ ውእቱ ፡
                  ወበከመ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ወበከመ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ንስሓ ።
verses.translation: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as a portion to them of the burnt-offerings of the Lord: it is most holy, as the offering for sin, and as the offering for trespass.

translations.lxx: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as a portion to them of the burnt-offerings of the Lord: it is most holy, as the offering for sin, and as the offering for trespass.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
translations.ron: Iar dimineaţa preotul să se îmbrace cu haina sa cea de în, după ce şi-a luat pantalonii săi cei de în pe trupul său, să ridice cenuşa arderii de tot, pe care a ars-o focul pe jertfelnic, şi s-o pună lângă jertfelnic.
translations.grk: Οὐ πεφθήσεται ἐζυμωμένη· μερίδα αὐτὴν ἔδωκα αὐτοῖς ἀπὸ τῶν καρπωμάτων Κυρίου· ἅγια ἁγίων ἐστὶν, ὥσπερ τὸ τῆς ἁμαρτίας, καὶ ὥσπερ τὸ τῆς πλημμελείας.

verses.geez:
ኵሉ ፡ ተባዕት ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ካህናት ፡ ይበልዖ ፤ ሕጉ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ዘለዓለም ፡ በመዋዕሊክሙ ፡ እምውስተ ፡
                  መሥዋዕቱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘገሰሰ ፡ ይትቄደስ ።
verses.translation: Every male of the priests shall eat it: it is a perpetual ordinance throughout your generations of the burnt-offerings of the Lord; whosoever shall touch them shall be hallowed.

translations.lxx: Every male of the priests shall eat it: it is a perpetual ordinance throughout your generations of the burnt-offerings of the Lord; whosoever shall touch them shall be hallowed.
translations.kjv: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
translations.ron: Apoi să-şi dezbrace hainele sale şi să se îmbrace cu alte haine şi să scoată cenuşa afară din tabără; la loc curat.
translations.grk: Πᾶν ἀρσενικὸν τῶν ἱερέων ἔδονται αὐτήν· νόμιμον αἰώνιον εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν ἀπὸ τῶν καρπωμάτων Κυρίου· πᾶς ὃς ἐὰν ἅψηται αὐτῶν, ἁγιασθήσεται.

verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.
translations.ron: Dar focul pe jertfelnic să ardă şi să nu se stingă; preotul să pună pe el lemne în fiecare dimineaţă, să aşeze pe el ardere de tot şi să ardă pe el grăsimea jertfei de mântuire.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων,

verses.geez:
ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘጸገውክዎ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወለደቂቁ ፡ እምነ ፡ ዘያመጽኡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እምአመ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ተቀብአ
                  ፡ ዓሥርተ ፡ እድ ፡ ዘመስፈርተ ፡ ኢፍ ፡ ስንዳሌ ፡ ወመሥዋዕትሰ ፡ ዘበኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ መንፈቃ ፡ ለነግህ ፡ ወመንፈቃ ፡ ለፍና
                  ፡ ሰርክ ።
verses.translation: This is the gift of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to the Lord in the day in which thou shalt anoint him; the tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sacrifice continually, the half of it in the morning, and the half of it in the evening.

translations.lxx: This is the gift of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to the Lord in the day in which thou shalt anoint him; the tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sacrifice continually, the half of it in the morning, and the half of it in the evening.
translations.kjv: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
translations.ron: Iar focul să ardă necontenit pe jertfelnic şi să nu se stingă.
translations.grk: τοῦτο τὸ δῶρον Ἀαρὼν καὶ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ, ὃ προσοίσουσι Κυρίῳ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ, ᾗ ἂν χρίσῃς αὐτόν· τὸ δέκατον τοῦ οἰφὶ σεμιδάλεως εἰς θυσίαν διαπαντὸς, τὸ ἥμισυ αὐτῆς τὸπρωῒ, καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ αὐτῆς τοδειλινόν.

verses.geez:
ምስለ ፡ ቅብእ ፡ በቴገን ፡ ይገብርዎ ፡ ወለዊሶሙ ፡ ያመጽእዎ ፡ እስመ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ፍቱት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወቍርባን ፡
                  ዘመዐዛ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: It shall be made with oil in a frying-pan; he shall offer it kneaded and in rolls, an offering of fragments, an offering of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

translations.lxx: It shall be made with oil in a frying-pan; he shall offer it kneaded and in rolls, an offering of fragments, an offering of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
translations.kjv: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.
translations.ron: Rânduiala prinosului de pâine, pe care preoţii, fiii lui Aaron, trebuie să-l aducă înaintea Domnului la jertfelnic, este aceasta:
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ τηγάνου ἐν ἐλαίῳ ποιηθήσεται, πεφυραμένην οἴσει αὐτήν ἑλικτά, θυσίαν ἐκ κλασμάτων, θυσίαν εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας Κυρίῳ.

verses.geez:
ካህን ፡ ዘቅቡእ ፡ ህየንቴሁ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ይገብሮ ፤ ሕጉ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘለዓለም ፡ ወበኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ ዘይትገበር
                  ።
verses.translation: The anointed priest who is in his place, one of his sons, shall offer it: it is a perpetual statute, it shall all be consumed.

translations.lxx: The anointed priest who is in his place, one of his sons, shall offer it: it is a perpetual statute, it shall all be consumed.
translations.kjv: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto the LORD.
translations.ron: Să ia preotul din prinosul acesta de pâine un pumn de făină de grâu, cu untdelemnul ei şi cu toată tămâia, care e pe prinos, şi să le ardă pe jertfelnic mireasmă plăcută de pomenire înaintea Domnului.
translations.grk: Ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ χριστὸς ὁ ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ ποιήσει αὐτήν· νόμος αἰώνιος· ἅπαν ἐπιτελεσθήσεται.

verses.geez: ወኵሉ ፡ መሥዋዕት ፡ ዘካህን ፡ ይነድድ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይትበላዕ ፡ እምኔሁ ።
verses.translation: And every sacrifice of a priest shall be thoroughly burnt, and shall not be eaten.

translations.lxx: And every sacrifice of a priest shall be thoroughly burnt, and shall not be eaten.
translations.kjv: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.
translations.ron: Iar rămăşiţa din ea s-o mănânce Aaron şi fiii lui şi s-o mănânce nedospită, în locul cel sfânt; în curtea cortului adunării s-o mănânce, dar să nu o coacă dospită.
translations.grk: Καὶ πᾶσα θυσία ἱερέως ὁλόκαυτος ἔσται, καὶ οὐ βρωθήσεται.

verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.
translations.ron: Aceasta le-o dau parte din jertfele Mele. Aceasta este sfinţenie mare, ca şi jertfa pentru păcat şi ca şi jertfa pentru vină.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων,

verses.geez:
ንግሮሙ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወለሰብኡ ፡ ወበሎሙ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሕጋ ፡ ለኀጢአት ፡ ውስተ ፡ መካን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ይጠብሑ ፡
                  ዘመሥዋዕት ፡ በህየ ፡ ይጠብሑ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአትኒ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ለቅዱሳን ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.translation: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin-offering;—in the place where they slay the whole-burnt-offering, they shall slay the sin-offerings before the Lord: they are most holy.

translations.lxx: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin-offering;—in the place where they slay the whole-burnt-offering, they shall slay the sin-offerings before the Lord: they are most holy.
translations.kjv: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the LORD made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.
translations.ron: Tot bărbatul din neamul preoţesc poate să mănânce din ea. Aceasta e lege veşnică în neamul vostru din jertfele Domnului. Tot ce se va atinge de ea, se va sfinţi".
translations.grk: λάλησον τῷ Ἀαρὼν καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ, λέγων, οὗτος ὁ νόμος τῆς ἁμαρτίας· ἐν τόπῳ οὗ σφάζουσι τὸ ὁλοκαύτωμα, σφάξουσι τὰ περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας ἔναντι Κυρίου· ἅγια ἁγίων ἐστίν.

verses.geez: ካህን ፡ ዘገብሮ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ይበልዖ ፡ ወበመካን ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ይበልዕዎ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ዐጸደ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: The priest that offers it shall eat it: in a holy place it shall be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: The priest that offers it shall eat it: in a holy place it shall be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: A grăit Domnul cu Moise şi a zis:
translations.grk: Ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ ἀναφέρων αὐτὴν, ἔδεται αὐτήν· ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ βρωθήσεται, ἐν αὐλῇ τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου.

verses.geez:
ኵሉ ፡ ዘገሰሶ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ይትቄደስ ፡ ወእመቦ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ተነዝኀ ፡ እምነ ፡ ደሙ ፡ እመኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልብስ ፡
                  ኀበ ፡ ተነዝኅ ፡ ዘውስቴቱ ፡ ተነዝኀ ፡ የኀፅብዎ ፡ በመካን ፡ ቅዱስ ።
verses.translation: Every one that touches the flesh of it shall be holy, and on whosesoever garment any of its blood shall have been sprinkled, whosoever shall have it sprinkled, shall be washed in the holy place.

translations.lxx: Every one that touches the flesh of it shall be holy, and on whosesoever garment any of its blood shall have been sprinkled, whosoever shall have it sprinkled, shall be washed in the holy place.
translations.kjv: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.
translations.ron: "Prinosul lui Aaron şi al fiilor lui, pe care-l vor aduce ei Domnului, în ziua ungerii lor, este acesta: făină bună de grâu, a zecea parte din efă, vor aduce jertfă necontenită; jumătate din ea dimineaţa şi jumătate seara.
translations.grk: Πᾶς ὁ ἁπτόμενος τῶν κρεῶν αὐτῆς, ἁγιασθήσεται· καὶ ᾧ ἐὰν ἐπιῤῥαντισθῇ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτῆς ἐπὶ τὸ ἱμάτιον, ὃς ἐὰν ῥαντισθῇ ἐπʼ αὐτὸ, πλυθήσεται ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ.

verses.geez:
ወልሕኵቱኒ ፡ ዘቦቱ ፡ አብሰልዎ ፡ ይሰብሩ ፡ ወእመሰ ፡ በንዋየ ፡ ብርት ፡ አብሰልዎ ፡ ያሐብርዎ ፡ ወየኀፅብዎ ፡ በማይ
                  ።
verses.translation: And the earthen vessel, in whichsoever it shall have been sodden, shall be broken; and if it shall have been sodden in a brazen vessel, he shall scour it and wash it with water.

translations.lxx: And the earthen vessel, in whichsoever it shall have been sodden, shall be broken; and if it shall have been sodden in a brazen vessel, he shall scour it and wash it with water.
translations.kjv: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
translations.ron: S-o gătească în tigaie, cu untdelemn; s-o rupi bucăţi, cum se rupe prinosul de pâine frământat cu untdelemn; să o aduci întru mireasmă plăcută Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ σκεῦος ὀστράκινον, οὗ ἐὰν ἑψεθῇ ἐν αὐτῷ, συντριβήσεται· ἐὰν δὲ ἐν σκεύει χαλκῷ ἑψηθῇ, ἐκτρίψει αὐτὸ, καὶ ἐκκλύσει ὕδατι.

verses.geez: ኵሉ ፡ ተባዕት ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ካህናት ፡ ይበልዖ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ለቅዱሳን ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: Every male among the priests shall eat it: it is most holy to the Lord.

translations.lxx: Every male among the priests shall eat it: it is most holy to the Lord.
translations.kjv: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto the LORD; it shall be wholly burnt.
translations.ron: Aceasta s-o săvârşească preotul, care se va mirui în locul lui Aaron, din fiii lui; acesta este aşezământ veşnic. Prinosul acesta să-l ardă tot.
translations.grk: Πᾶς ἄρσην ἐν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν φάγεται αὐτά ἅγια ἁγίων ἐστὶ Κυρίῳ.

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ዘያበውኡ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ደሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ያስተ[ስ]ርዩ ፡ ቦቱ ፡
                  ውስተ ፡ ቅድሳት ፡ ኢይትበላዕ ፤ በእሳት ፡ ያነድድዎ ።
verses.translation: And no offerings for sin, of whose blood there shall be brought any into the tabernacle of witness to make atonement in the holy place, shall be eaten: they shall be burned with fire.

translations.lxx: And no offerings for sin, of whose blood there shall be brought any into the tabernacle of witness to make atonement in the holy place, shall be eaten: they shall be burned with fire.
translations.kjv: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
translations.ron: Orice prinos de pâine din partea preotului să se ardă tot şi să nu se mănânce nimic din el".
translations.grk: Καὶ πάντα τὰ περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας, ὧν ἐὰν εἰσενεχθῇ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτῶν εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐξιλάσασθαι ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ, οὐ βρωθήσεται· ἐν πυρὶ κατακαυθήσεται.
